faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about how FitCoach works and what to expect from your personalized program.
faq.q1: Do I need a gym membership to start?
faq.a1: Not at all. While a gym membership offers more equipment variety, your coach will design your program based completely on what you have access to. Whether you train at a fully equipped commercial gym, a home garage gym, or just use your bodyweight in your living room, we will build a plan that gets results.
faq.q2: How long until I see results?
faq.a2: Most clients notice improved energy and better sleep within the first 1-2 weeks. Visible physical changes and strength improvements typically become noticeable around weeks 4-6. Remember, we are building sustainable habits, not just temporary fixes.
faq.q3: Are meal plans included in all tiers?
faq.a3: We focus on flexible nutrition coaching rather than rigid meal plans. We will provide calorie and macro targets, along with portion guides and recipe ideas, tailored to your goals. This ensures you learn how to eat for your body without feeling restricted or giving up your favorite foods.
faq.q4: What if I have a pre-existing injury?
faq.a4: During your initial onboarding assessment, you'll detail any past or current injuries. Your coach is trained to work around limitations, providing alternative exercises and mobility work to keep you progressing safely without aggravating the issue.
faq.q5: How does the communication with my coach work?
faq.a5: Depending on your coaching tier, you'll have access to your coach via our dedicated app chat for quick form checks and questions. Core and Elite plans also include weekly check-ins via form or video to review your progress, adjust macros, and update your training program.
faq.q6: Can I cancel my coaching subscription at any time?
faq.a6: Yes, there are no long-term contracts holding you back. We operate on a month-to-month basis. If you feel you've reached your goals or need a break, you can cancel your subscription anytime before your next billing cycle.

timeline.mainDesc: From your very first session to long-term results — here's exactly what your coaching journey looks like.
timeline.s1Desc: We start with a comprehensive fitness assessment — your goals, current fitness level, schedule, injuries, and nutrition habits. This gives your coach a full picture to build your personalized program from day one.
timeline.s2Desc: Within 48 hours of your assessment, your coach delivers a fully custom workout plan and nutrition guide built specifically for your body and goals — no templates, no guesswork.
timeline.s2Item2: Macro & calorie targets set for your goal
timeline.s3Desc: You train, we track. Every week your coach reviews your progress, adjusts the plan if needed, and holds a video check-in to keep you accountable and motivated. Your program evolves as you do.
timeline.s3Item3: Plan updated based on real performance data
timeline.s3Item4: 24/7 chat access for form checks & questions
timeline.s4Desc: Real, lasting results — not a quick fix. After hitting your initial goal, your coach helps you set the next one and build lifelong habits so you never have to start over again.
